newsitem.title: SPAIN: Fasa Renault Spain aid decision temporary.
newsitem.headline: Fasa Renault Spain aid decision temporary.

text.p: Renault's Spanish unit Fasa Renault said on Friday that Spain's decision to withdraw a request to the European Commission to aid it was temporary and that Spain backed its projects.

In a statement, chairman Juan Antonio Moral said the "suspension was exclusively temporary for a technical revision" and that "the Spanish government has assured it that the project would continue with its support."
